validation_checks: Data completeness and integrity check for concentration-time, PD biomarker, efficacy, covariate, and safety records across 240 patients
PK model fit comparison via OFV and visual predictive checks (VPC) for both 1- and 2-compartment models
Covariate effect screening: assess material covariate relationships to exposure (AUC) for weight_kg, creatinine_clearance_ml_min, and genotype
Efficacy PD/response model: logistic regression or similar of clinical_response against individual AUC estimates with 95% CI
Safety PD model: logistic regression or similar of grade2plus_adverse_event against individual AUC estimates with 95% CI
Predictive performance check: simulate 1000 replicates under final model to verify predictive interval coverage for concentration and response
Parameter uncertainty quantification: bootstrap or likelihood profiling for all structural and covariate parameters
Covariate balance check: confirm adequate sample size and exposure range within each covariate stratum to support inference
dosing_policy: Conservative dosing recommendations will be issued only when PK model selection is definitive, covariate effects on exposure are material and confirmed, and efficacy–safety PD relationships are established with sufficient precision. Any material covariate effect lacking exposure-matched simulation data will result in insufficient evidence for dose adjustment rather than an invented or extrapolated dose recommendation.
